findings.evidence: template/scripts/requirement_intake.py:342-344 selects every open Requirement in the shared Backlog repository without checking config.project_label or the target repository. template/scripts/managed_project_status.py:204-218 resolves every selected Issue against the current checkout’s project_owner/project_number. When targets share a Backlog repository but configure different Projects, --all creates unwanted memberships. An in-memory replay with project:billing configuration selected a project:crm Requirement for reconciliation.
findings.summary: Bulk reconciliation can add another target’s Requirements to the wrong Project.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/managed_project_status.py:427-435 reads Status and then performs an unconditional update when the observed value is None. A claim occurring between those operations is overwritten; the final read-back accepts the resulting Backlog value. An in-memory replay inserted an In progress claim after the read and confirmed that ensure_item returned a successful Backlog receipt. tests/test_managed_project_status.py:175 tests a claim after the update, which does not cover this ordering.
findings.summary: Status initialization can silently overwrite a concurrent claim with Backlog.
